result_text:
I fixed both defects in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/generators/statichtml/LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.java`. The module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for these cases, so neither fix has been exercised.

1. **Group link crash:** in `mergeIntoGroupLink`, the reverse-direction branch read the count from a link that doesn't exist yet, which caused the NullPointerException. It now adds to the existing reverse link's own count. Your example (3 files from Group 1 to Group 2, 2 files back) should give one Group 1 → Group 2 link labelled 5.
2. **Zero-LOC percentage:** `getShareOfComponentLinesOfCode` now returns 0 when the component has no counted lines. The text then reads "0%". The bar width overflow also goes away: `SimpleOneBarChart.getPercentageSvg` already clamps the bar to a minimum width of 1, so no change was needed there.
